verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's API surfaces the underlying data a finance lead would need — nexus by jurisdiction, filings, registrations, transaction sync and credit notes/refund adjustments — via endpoints like get-nexus-for-org, get-filings, and syncing-transaction-records, which could in principle be assembled into a liability view. However, there is no evidence of a purpose-built 'accrued liability by jurisdiction' report, a collected-vs-owed dashboard, or filing-ready GL export formats for accountants; everything shown is raw API/CSV plumbing rather than a finance-facing report. Missing for 10: a dedicated liability/collected-vs-owed report UI, documented GL/accountant export formats (e.g. journal entry exports), and any evidence of accountant-consumable output beyond raw API objects.
